_note: Draft written 2026-11-17 in the brand voice (design-system/docs/brand-guidelines.md §8: plain, second person, sentence case, headlines of 7 words or fewer). Facts come from Ptuj's data and each place's own website. Needs a read by someone who knows Ptuj before publishing.
lede: Know where to ride, stay, eat and refill in Ptuj.
intro: Ptuj, often called the oldest town in Slovenia, sits on the Drava below its castle. Three signed routes run through it: the Drava Cycle Route (Dravska kolesarska pot) along the river, the Kolesarska Jakobova pot through the centre, and the local route LAS-8.

routes.title: Cycle routes through Ptuj
routes.body: Three signed routes cross Ptuj, and two of them are long. The Drava Cycle Route follows the river for 190 km, 17 km of it in Ptuj. The Prekmurje and Štajerska branch of the Jakobova pot runs 263 km and passes through the centre. A local route completes the list: LAS-8, 16 km.

stays.title: Where to stay with your bike
stays.body: Ptuj has 14 places to stay, and the ones in the centre are a few steps from the Jakobova pot. Sobe Proštija, by the parish church on Slovenski trg, is 16 metres from the route. MuziKafe, a B&B in a house from 1618, is 79 metres away. Want a pool after the ride? Grand hotel Primus at Terme Ptuj is 66 metres from the same route, with thermal pools and saunas.

food.title: Where to stop and eat
food.body: Ptuj has 23 places to eat, and pizza is easy to find on the routes. Pivnica Zlatorog sits right on the Jakobova pot and is open every day. Pizzeria Slonček, below the castle, is 11 metres from the Drava Cycle Route. For ice cream and desserts made in house, Pomaranča by the Drava is 45 metres from the Jakobova pot. Gostilna pri ovinku, on the edge of town, cooks Slovenian food and opens every day.

practical.title: Water, repair and charging
practical.body: Almost every water point is on a route: 9 of the 10 public water points are within 150 metres of a signed route. For repairs there are two public repair stands and three bike shops. E-bike riders can use 4 public chargers.

sights.title: What to see on the way
sights.body: You can see most of Ptuj without leaving the Drava route. Ptuj Castle stands on its hill above the river, 113 metres from the Drava Cycle Route. The Dominican Monastery is 15 metres from the route and the water tower 14 metres. The Panorama archaeological site is 79 metres away, and Turnišče Castle is a detour of just under 2 km.

places._note: One line per place, keyed by the start of its id, written from the place's own website. A place without a line shows its type and town.
places.f74e17f7: A B&B and café in a renovated house from 1618, with rooms from small doubles to a suite and regular music and cultural events.
places.486d871e: A hotel with a casino on Vinarski trg in the centre of Ptuj.
places.ffb19e2f: Four rooms in the old provost's house next to the parish church and bell tower in the centre of Ptuj.
places.b2f37c63: A modern hotel at Terme Ptuj, run by Sava Hotels & Resorts, with thermal pools, saunas and a golf course next door.
places.f08f95b2: A family café, restaurant and boutique hotel by the Drava, open since 2004. Ice cream and desserts are made in house.
places.2aecdaa3: A restaurant in Spuhlja serving daily lunches and à la carte dishes. Open Monday to Thursday from 10:00 to 21:00, Friday from 10:00 to 22:00 and Saturday from 11:00 to 22:00. On Sundays and holidays it opens from 12:00 to 21:00.
places.a5274d20: A pub and snack bar on Slomškova ulica, best known for its pizza. Open every day.
places.705dea58: A pizzeria on the town's oldest street, just below Ptuj Castle, with decades of pizza-making behind it. Delivery within Ptuj is free.
places.e6b8ffd7: A pizzeria on Vošnjakova ulica with a dining room and a summer terrace, also serving lasagne and toasted sandwiches.
places.9b1d06c1: An inn on the edge of Ptuj cooking fresh Slovenian food with meat and wine from local producers. Open every day.
